<reason>PRO wins by narrowing the motion to time-limited, notified emergency restrictions rather than a ban on bans, then showing such precommitment deters pre-emptive, open-ended bans and cascades even without instant tribunal action. CON powerfully stresses breach under existential pressure, but never answers the pre-emptive-ban case and relies on domestic accountability, which PRO decisively shows rewards exporting harm to neighbours who cannot vote.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>Most decisive was PRO's Rebuttal 2 and Closing: automatic expiry known on day one answers the 72-hour objection, while CON's admitted political-survival check is exposed as pointing the wrong way because home voters benefit from prolonged bans.</best_rebuttal>
